IODA_CLAMP_LIMITS.title: Clamp over-cap inputs
IODA_CLAMP_LIMITS.description: Serve an over-cap limit, maxPoints, lookbackHours, or extendWindowSeconds at its cap with a notice. Set false to reject it and advertise each cap as the schema maximum.
